svg.title: Security findings and run state connections
svg.desc: Inputs, outputs, durable state, evidence, failure, and recovery relationships for Security findings and run state.

g.text: Security findings and run state connections

a.xlink:title: Security scan coordinator. Validates Quick, Full, and App Check requests, tracks active runs, and exposes compact split-read summaries.
Security findings and run state. Stores scan runs, tools, progress, findings, profile snapshots, and sanitized evidence references.
SQLite control-plane store. Stores canonical Lite lifecycle state and prepared projections; the frontend never accesses it directly.
Lynis and Trivy scanner adapters. Run bounded backend-owned scanners with target-aware exclusions and sanitized evidence; the browser never executes scanners.
